name: Magus Ace Pilot
body:
An ace pilot is a terror on the field of mechanized combat.

Their prowess is such that friends and enemies alike often wonder if the secret to their success is due to their raw talent or the mech they pilot. The answer is both.

Diminished Spellcasting

An ace pilot casts one fewer spell of each level than normal. If this reduces the number to 0, he may cast spells of that level only if his Intelligence allows bonus spells of that level. This ability alters the magus’s spellcasting.

Bonded Mech

The ace pilot gains a bonded mech*, treating his class level as his pilot level.

Blackbox System (Su)

The ace pilot may spend a point from his arcane pool as a swift action to gain a number of temporary points of essence equal to 1/2 his magus level (minimum 1). This temporary essence lasts for 1 minute and may be assigned as part of the same action to generate it.

The ace pilot may assign essence to his bonded mech using any of the essence receptacles available to a 2nd-level helmsman* through the akashic armaments class feature.

At 9th level, the ace pilot may assign essence to his bonded mech using any of the essence receptacles available to an 11th-level helmsman through the akashic armaments class feature.

At 17th level, the ace pilot may assign essence to his bonded mech using any of the essence receptacles available to a 17th-level helmsman through the akashic armaments class feature.

This replaces the magus’ ability to grant enhancement bonuses and weapon special abilities to weapons with his arcane pool.

Pilot’s Arcana

The ace pilot may select the following magus arcana:

Mage’s Hypercharge (Su)

The ace pilot may spend a point from his arcane pool as a free action to gain a temporary pool of boost points equal to 1/2 his class level + his Intelligence bonus (minimum 1). These boost points last for a number of rounds equal to the ace pilot’s class level and may be spent to activate any hypercharge he knows.

Overlapping activations of overdrive extend the duration of the boost pool but cannot raise the total number of boost points beyond the ace pilot’s 1/2 his class level + his Intelligence bonus. The total boost cost of each overdrive is detailed in its description.

As part of gaining this magus arcana, the ace pilot chooses a single hypercharge from the helmsman class, using his ace pilot level as his helmsman level.

Manifold Hypercharge (Ex) (Requires Mage’s Hypercharge)

The ace pilot chooses a single hypercharge from the helmsman class, using his ace pilot level as his helmsman level. This magus arcana may be selected multiple times.
